Does LBL follow bar ethics rules when writing legal content?

Yes. We never use promise language ("we'll win your case", "best attorney in the state"). All content uses process language and avoids any outcome claims or guarantees. Posts are educational in tone — consumer rights, what to expect from a process — not promotional. We apply conservative defaults that are safe across all state bars.
How do you handle review responses for a law firm?

Every positive review gets a professional, empathetic reply within 1 hour. We never confirm representation, discuss case details, or say anything that could raise privilege concerns. For negative reviews, we send you a draft for approval — because how you respond to a difficult review says more about your firm than the review itself.
Why does each review matter so much more for law firms?

Law firms typically have 15–80 reviews versus 200+ for restaurants. This means each individual review carries disproportionate weight on your average. A single 1-star on a 20-review profile is visible to every prospective client. Fast, professional responses to all reviews — positive and negative — are the single most important GBP activity for a law firm.
What practice areas does LBL support?

We work with firms across personal injury, family law, criminal defense, estate planning, business law, immigration, and more. At signup you tell us your practice areas, and we calibrate posts and review responses to match — making sure you appear in the right searches for the services you actually offer.
